headline: 首列检测车开行 ！中交马东铁动态检测正式启动
english_headline: First Test Train Departs! Dynamic Testing Officially Starts for CCCC's East Coast Rail Link
english_excerpt: Kuala Lumpur, August 22 (Reporter Liu Yu-ying) - China News Service reports that as the first test train set off, Phase 1 of the East Coast Rail Link (ECRL) in Malaysia—a flagship project of high-quality Belt and Road cooperation between China and Malaysia, spanning from Kota Bharu in Kelantan to Gombak in Selangor—has officially entered the stage of dynamic testing and fault-free operation, according to the CCCC ECRL project team.
background_en: The commencement of dynamic testing for the ECRL marks a milestone in the China-Malaysia 'Belt and Road' infrastructure collaboration.
